title: Monkeys fear to jump the ocean
introduction: Monkeys are perturbed to see ocean which is breadthwise a hundred yojana-s, say a thousand miles, as none can leap a. Every important monkey says that his capability is just lesser than that. Angada is again despaired as none is coming forward, nor he is allowed to go, in the name of his prospective kingship. But Jambavanta pacifies and starts to encourage and invigorate Hanuma to undertake the task of leaping the ocean.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे पंच षष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 65th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अथ अंगद वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वे ते वानर उत्तमाः |
स्वम् स्वम् गतौ समुत्साहम् ऊचुः तत्र यथा क्रमम्
गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गंधमादनः |
मैन्दः च द्विविदः चैव सुषेणो जांबवान् तथा
verses.iast:
atha aṃgada vacaḥ śrutvā sarve te vānara uttamāḥ |
svam svam gatau samutsāham ūcuḥ tatra yathā kramam
gajo gavākṣo gavayaḥ śarabho gaṃdhamādanaḥ |
maindaḥ ca dvividaḥ caiva suṣeṇo jāmbavān tathā
verses.translation: Then on hearing the words of Angada those best vanara-s, anamely Gaja, Gavaaksha, Gavaya, Sharabha, Gandhamaadana, Mainda and Dvivida, and Susheshana, and like that Jambavanta have individually said about their abilities in the matter of leaping the ocean according to their turn.

glosses.itrans: gajaH gavaakSaH gavayaH sharabhaH ga.ndhamaadanaH maindaH
glosses.iast: gajaḥ gavākṣaḥ gavayaḥ śarabhaḥ gaṃdhamādanaḥ maindaḥ
glosses.devanagari: गजः गवाक्षः गवयः शरभः गंधमादनः मैन्दः
glosses.meaning: Gaja, Gavaaksha, Gavaya, Sharabha, Gandhamaadana, Mainda

verses.devanagari:
आबभाषे गजः तत्र प्लवेयम् दश योजनम् |
गवाक्षो योजनानि आह गमिष्यामि इति विंशतिम्
verses.iast:
ābabhāṣe gajaḥ tatra plaveyam daśa yojanam |
gavākṣo yojanāni āha gamiṣyāmi iti viṃśatim
verses.translation: In that matter Gaja said, "I can fly ten yojana-s..." and Gavaaksha said, "I can go over twenty yojana-s..."

glosses.meaning: Gaja, ten, yojana-s, I can fly, said
Gavaaksha, twenty, yojana-s, I can go

verses.devanagari:
शरभो वानरः तत्र वानरान् तान् उवाच ह |
त्रिंशत् गमिष्यामि योजनानाम् प्लवंगमाः
ऋषरभो वानरः तत्र वानरान् तान् उवाच ह |
चत्वारिंशत् गमिष्यामि योजनानाम् न संशयः
वानरान् तु महातेजा अब्रवीत् गंधमादनः |
योजनानाम् गमिष्यामि पंचाशत् तु न संशयः
मैन्दः तु वानरः तत्र वानरान् तान् उवाच ह |
योजनानाम् परम् षष्टिम् अहम् प्लवितुम् उत्सहे
ततः तत्र महातेजा द्विविदः प्रत्यभाषत |
गमिष्यामि न संदेहः सप्ततिम् योजनानि अहम्
सुषेणः तु महातेजाः सत्त्ववान् कपि सत्तमः |
अशीतिम् प्रतिजाने अहम् योजनानाम् पराक्रमे
verses.iast:
śarabho vānaraḥ tatra vānarān tān uvāca ha |
triṃśat gamiṣyāmi yojanānām plavaṃgamāḥ
ṛṣarabho vānaraḥ tatra vānarān tān uvāca ha |
catvāriṃśat gamiṣyāmi yojanānām na saṃśayaḥ
vānarān tu mahātejā abravīt gaṃdhamādanaḥ |
yojanānām gamiṣyāmi paṃcāśat tu na saṃśayaḥ
maindaḥ tu vānaraḥ tatra vānarān tān uvāca ha |
yojanānām param ṣaṣṭim aham plavitum utsahe
tataḥ tatra mahātejā dvividaḥ pratyabhāṣata |
gamiṣyāmi na saṃdehaḥ saptatim yojanāni aham
suṣeṇaḥ tu mahātejāḥ sattvavān kapi sattamaḥ |
aśītim pratijāne aham yojanānām parākrame
verses.translation: In that matter the vanara Sharabha said to the monkeys, "oh, fly-jumpers, I can indeed go up to thirty yojana-s..." The vanara Sharabha said, "I can go up to forty yojana-s, undoubtedly..." The great-resplendent Gandhamaadana said, "I can go up to fifty yojana-s, no doubt..." The vanara Mainda said the monkeys in that matter, "I venture to jump just sixty yojana-s..." Then the great-resplendent Dvivida informed, "I can go up to seventy yojana-s, no doubt..." But mighty Shushena, the best and the great resplendent monkey said, "I promise to jump eighty yojana-s..."

glosses.meaning: yojana-s, up to thirty, I can go
yojana-s, up to forty, I can go

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् कथयताम् तत्र सर्वान् तान् अनुमान्य च |
ततो वृद्धतमः तेषाम् जांबवान् प्रत्यभाषत
verses.iast:
teṣām kathayatām tatra sarvān tān anumānya ca |
tato vṛddhatamaḥ teṣām jāmbavān pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: Jambavanta, the oldest one among all of them, appreciating them who are telling about their jumping capacities, has informed them in this way.

glosses.meaning: by them, in that matter, while saying so
to them said - in this way.

verses.devanagari:
पूर्वम् अस्माकम् अपि आसीत् कश्चित् गति पराक्रमः |
ते वयम् वयसः पारम् अनुप्राप्ताः स्म सांप्रतम्
verses.iast:
pūrvam asmākam api āsīt kaścit gati parākramaḥ |
te vayam vayasaḥ pāram anuprāptāḥ sma sāmpratam
verses.translation: "Previously there was some traversal daredevilry even for us, such as we were, we are presently on the other shore of our age...
notes: The use of the word 'us' is to mean 'for me...' as a kind of royal 'we'.

glosses.meaning: of age, other shore, reached, we are - I am.

verses.devanagari:
किम् तु न एवम् गते शक्यम् इदम् कार्यम् उपेक्षितुम् |
यद् अर्थम् कपि राजः च रामः च कृत निश्चयौ
verses.iast:
kim tu na evam gate śakyam idam kāryam upekṣitum |
yad artham kapi rājaḥ ca rāmaḥ ca kṛta niścayau
verses.translation: "That being so, for which purpose the king of monkeys Sugreeva and even Rama are decisively decided on this task, it is impossible for us to marginalize this task...
notes: Jambavanta is cautioning the monkeys, who are evasive on the issue of going to Ravana's Lanka. When Sugreeva sent the very same monkeys to all directions, he said 'you all have an unimpeded egress and no limits for your capabilities...' etc., but here, all the monkeys are telling their capacity is 'a little lesser than a hundred yojana long jump...' It is not exactly their lack of aptitude to 'just jump' but it is their 'fear for Ravana' that is deterring them. As such, here Jambavanta as the senior most member had to reprimand them with words like 'non-observance, heedlessness...' etc.

glosses.meaning: decisively, decided - on getting their task solved

verses.devanagari:
सांप्रतम् कालम् अस्माकम् या गतिः ताम् निबोधत |
नवतिम् योजनानाम् तु गमिष्यामि न संशयः
verses.iast:
sāmpratam kālam asmākam yā gatiḥ tām nibodhata |
navatim yojanānām tu gamiṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "While we say you may hear what cruise we have at this age... we can go up to ninety yojana-s, undoubtedly...

glosses.meaning: in present, time - at this age
what, cruise, that, while I say [you understand]

verses.devanagari:
तान् च सर्वान् हरि श्रेष्ठान् जांबवान् इदम् अब्रवीत् |
न खलु एतावत् एव आसीत् गमने मे पराक्रमः
verses.iast:
tān ca sarvān hari śreṣṭhān jāmbavān idam abravīt |
na khalu etāvat eva āsīt gamane me parākramaḥ
verses.translation: Jambavanta further said this to all of those best monkeys, "my capability in the stint of going was not definitely limited only thereunto...

glosses.meaning: to all of, those, to monkey, best ones
to me, in [the stint of] going, capability

verses.devanagari:
मया वैरोचने यज्ञे प्रभविष्णुः सनातनः |
प्रदक्षिणी कृतः पूर्वम् क्रममाणः त्रिविक्रमः
verses.iast:
mayā vairocane yajñe prabhaviṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ |
pradakṣiṇī kṛtaḥ pūrvam kramamāṇaḥ trivikramaḥ
verses.translation: "Once I have performed circumambulation around the Omnipresent and Eternal Vishnu in His incarnation as Trivikrama, when He grandiosely increased His physique from that of a Divine-Dwarfish Brahman boy to that of an Omnidirectional Being, thus filling whole of the Universe to tread all the three worlds, during the time of Vedic-ritual of Emperor Bali, the legatee of Vairocana...

glosses.meaning: in Vairocana's legatee's [Emperor Bali's,] Vedic-ritual's - at the time of]
circumambulation, He was made by me.

verses.devanagari:
स इदानीम् अहम् वृद्धः प्लवने मन्दविक्रमः |
यौवने च तदा आसीत् मे बलम् अप्रतिमम् परम्
verses.iast:
sa idānīm aham vṛddhaḥ plavane mandavikramaḥ |
yauvane ca tadā āsīt me balam apratimam param
verses.translation: "Such as I was, I am presently old and decrepit and I have become slow jumping soldier of misfortune, though my energy in youth was unmatchable and unsurpassable.

verses.devanagari:
संप्रति एतावत् एव अद्य शक्यम् मे गमने स्वतः |
न एतावता च संसिद्धिः कार्यस्य अस्य भविष्यति
verses.iast:
samprati etāvat eva adya śakyam me gamane svataḥ |
na etāvatā ca saṃsiddhiḥ kāryasya asya bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "Now, at this age it is possible for me to go on my own only thereunto... and by that much endeavour that task will be unaccomplished..." So said Jambavanta to monkeys.

glosses.meaning: now, for me, on my own, in going

verses.devanagari:
अथ उत्तरम् उदार अर्थम् अब्रवीत् अंगदः तदा |
अनुमान्य महाप्राज्ञो जांबवंतम् महाकपिम्
verses.iast:
atha uttaram udāra artham abravīt aṃgadaḥ tadā |
anumānya mahāprājño jāmbavaṃtam mahākapim
verses.translation: Then on reverencing the great monkey Jambavanta, the highly intelligent Angada thereafter said these salutary words.
notes: Though Jambavanta is a bear he is reckoned as one with monkeys because bear's nature and behaviour 'nearly' equals that of gorillas, chimps, or even monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
अहम् एतत् गमिष्यामि योजनानाम् शतम् महत् |
निवर्तने तु मे शक्तिः स्यात् न वा इति न निश्चितम्
verses.iast:
aham etat gamiṣyāmi yojanānām śatam mahat |
nivar.htane tu me śaktiḥ syāt na vā iti na niścitam
verses.translation: "I can vault over this ocean which is broadwise in a hundred yojana-breadth, but whether I am capable of coming back or not, it is indefinite...

glosses.meaning: in returning, to me, capability, is there

verses.devanagari:
तम् उवाच हरि श्रेष्ठो जांबवान् वाक्य कोविदः |
ज्ञायते गमने शक्तिः तव हरि ऋक्ष सत्तम
verses.iast:
tam uvāca hari śreṣṭho jāmbavān vākya kovidaḥ |
jñāyate gamane śaktiḥ tava hari ṛkṣa sattama
verses.translation: That expert in sentence making, Jambavanta said to the best one among monkeys namely Angada, "oh, Angada, the best one among monkeys and bears, I know about your capability in traversal...

glosses.meaning: him, to monkey, the best - Angada
oh, among monkeys, bears, best one - oh, Jambavanta
in traversal, your, capability, is known.

verses.devanagari:
कामम् शत सहस्रम् वा न हि एष विधिः उच्यते |
योजनानाम् भवान् शक्तो गन्तुम् प्रतिनिवर्तितुम्
verses.iast:
kāmam śata sahasram vā na hi eṣa vidhiḥ ucyate |
yojanānām bhavān śakto gantum pratinivartitum
verses.translation: "Why a hundred, if need be you are capable to go up to a hundred thousand yojana-s and come back... but this method of our sending you is uncanonical...

verses.devanagari:
न हि प्रेषयिता तात स्वामी प्रेष्यः कथंचन |
भवता अयम् जनः सर्वः प्रेष्यः प्लवग सत्तम
verses.iast:
na hi preṣayitā tāta svāmī preṣyaḥ kathaṃcana |
bhavatā ayam janaḥ sarvaḥ preṣyaḥ plavaga sattama
verses.translation: "Oh, dear Angada, in anyway lord assigner cannot be an assignee, hence oh, best fly-jumper, all of these people are assignable by you...

verses.devanagari:
भवान् कलत्रम् अस्माकम् स्वामि भावे व्यवस्थितः |
स्वामी कलत्रम् सैन्यस्य गतिः एषा परंतप
verses.iast:
bhavān kalatram asmākam svāmi bhāve vyavasthitaḥ |
svāmī kalatram sainyasya gatiḥ eṣā paraṃtapa
verses.translation: "You are notionally established as our lord and we have to become your protectionists and, oh, enemy-inflamer Angada, lord becomes the protectionist of army... this alone is the method...
notes: The word kalatra meaning 'that which need be protected,' has other meanings like 'wife, buttock...' etc.

glosses.meaning: as lord, in notion of, established
for us, you are to be protected
lord, for army, is to be protected

verses.devanagari:
अपि वै एतस्य कार्यस्य भवान् मूलम् अरिम् दम |
तस्मात् कलत्रवत् तात प्रतिपाल्यः सदा भवान्
verses.iast:
api vai etasya kāryasya bhavān mūlam arim dama |
tasmāt kalatravat tāta pratipālyaḥ sadā bhavān
verses.translation: "Oh, enemy-subjugator, really you are the linchpin to this mission, thereby oh, dear Angada, you are always to be protected like anything that needs safeguarding...

verses.devanagari:
मूलम् अर्थस्य संरक्ष्यम् एष कार्यविदाम् नयः |
मूले हि सति सिध्यन्ति गुणाः पुष्प फल उदयः
verses.iast:
mūlam arthasya saṃrakṣyam eṣa kār.hyavidām nayaḥ |
mūle hi sati sidhyanti guṇāḥ puṣpa phala udayaḥ
verses.translation: " 'The prime mover of a task is to be safeguarded...' is the byword of the taskmasters, and indeed if only the prime mover is there, all the endowments are achievable that yield fruits...

glosses.meaning: of purpose [task,] prime mover, is to be safeguarded
prime mover, if only it is there

verses.devanagari:
तद् भवान् अस्य कार्यस्य साधनम् सत्य विक्रमः |
बुद्धि विक्रम संपन्नो हेतुः अत्र परंतपः
verses.iast:
tad bhavān asya kāryasya sādhanam satya vikramaḥ |
buddhi vikrama sampanno hetuḥ atra paraṃtapaḥ
verses.translation: "Thereby, oh, truth-valiant Angada, you are instrumental to this task and as you are privileged with sagacity and audacity, oh, enemy-inflamer, you are the keystone for this task of searching Seetha...

glosses.meaning: thereby, you are, of this, task's, instrument

verses.devanagari:
गुरुः च गुरु पुत्रः च त्वम् हि नः कपि सत्तम |
भवन्तम् आश्रित्य वयम् समर्था हि अर्थ साधने
verses.iast:
guruḥ ca guru putraḥ ca tvam hi naḥ kapi sattama |
bhavantam āśritya vayam samarthā hi artha sādhane
verses.translation: "For us you are indeed a respectable one by yourself, and as the son of respected Vali too, and oh, best monkey, sheltered by you we are indeed capable of achieving the objective of our task..." So said Jambavanta to Angada.

glosses.meaning: for us, respected one's [Vali's,] son, too
you are, a respectable one, also
objective [of our task,] in achieving, we will be capable, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
उक्त वाक्यम् महाप्राज्ञम् जांबवंतम् महाकपिः |
प्रत्युवाच उत्तरम् वाक्यम् वालि सूनुः अथ अंगदः
verses.iast:
ukta vākyam mahāprājñam jāmbavaṃtam mahākapiḥ |
pratyuvāca uttaram vākyam vāli sūnuḥ atha aṃgadaḥ
verses.translation: When that highly scholarly Jambavanta has said thus, the great monkey and the son of Vali Angada said this sentence in reply as an answer.

glosses.meaning: to one who has said his sentence - to Jambavanta

verses.devanagari:
यदि न अहम् गमिष्यामि न अन्यो वानर पुंगवः |
पुनः खलु इदम् अस्माभिः कार्यम् प्रायोपवेशनम्
verses.iast:
yadi na aham gamiṣyāmi na anyo vānara puṃgavaḥ |
punaḥ khalu idam asmābhiḥ kāryam prāyopaveśanam
verses.translation: "If I am not proceeding to Lanka, nor any other monkey is proceeding, then we have to undertake self-immolation once again, isn't it!

glosses.meaning: other, monkey, the best, not [does not go]
this, self-immolation, is to be undertaken, is it not.

verses.devanagari:
न हि अकृत्वा हरि पतेः संदेशम् तस्य धीमतः |
तत्र अपि गत्वा प्राणानाम् न पश्यामि परिरक्षणम्
verses.iast:
na hi akṛtvā hari pateḥ saṃdeśam tasya dhīmataḥ |
tatra api gatvā prāṇānām na paśyāmi parirakṣaṇam
verses.translation: "I do not perceive any secure protection for our lives on our going to Kishkindha without fulfilling the bidding of that resolute king of monkeys Sugreeva...

glosses.meaning: to there [to Kishkindha,] on going, even
secure protection = na pashyaami = not, I perceive.

verses.devanagari:
स हि प्रसादे च अत्यर्थम् कोपे च हरिः ईश्वरः |
अतीत्य तस्य संदेशम् विनाशो गमने भवेत्
verses.iast:
sa hi prasāde ca atyartham kope ca hariḥ īśvaraḥ |
atītya tasya saṃdeśam vināśo gamane bhavet
verses.translation: "Sugreeva is a lord who shows either forgiveness or furiousness immoderately... and our going to Kishkindha trespassing his bidding is as good as our entering into our own doom...

glosses.meaning: immoderately, a lord - will lord over
will be - it I as good as entering our own doom.]

verses.devanagari:
तत् तथा हि अस्य कार्यस्य न भवति अन्यथा गतिः |
तत् भवान् एव दृष्ट अर्थः संचिंतयितुम् अर्हति
verses.iast:
tat tathā hi asya kāryasya na bhavati anyathā gatiḥ |
tat bhavān eva dṛṣṭa arthaḥ sañciṃtayitum ar.hhati
verses.translation: "It will happen in that way only as our going back to Kishkindha results in no other way, thereby it will be apt of you to think deeply, as you can envision the implications..." Thus Angada said to Jambavanta.

glosses.meaning: that, that way, only - it will happen in that way only
that, task's [our return to Kishkindha,] course - result
other way round, not, will become - it will not be other way round
to deeply think, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
सः अंगदेन तदा वीरः प्रत्युक्तः प्लवगर्षभः |
जांबवान् उत्तमम् वाक्यम् प्रोवाच इदम् ततो अंगदम्
verses.iast:
saḥ aṃgadena tadā vīraḥ pratyuktaḥ plavagarṣabhaḥ |
jāmbavān uttamam vākyam provāca idam tato aṃgadam
verses.translation: When that best and valiant fly-jumper Jambavanta is said that way by Angada, then Jambavanta advised him in this best sentence to Angada.

glosses.meaning: by Angada, that way, who is replied [Jambavanta]
best, this one, the sentence, spoke - advised.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य ते वीर कार्यस्य न किंचित् परिहास्यते |
एष संचोदयामि एनम् यः कार्यम् साधयिष्यति
verses.iast:
tasya te vīra kāryasya na kiñcit parihāsyate |
eṣa sañcodayāmi enam yaḥ kāryam sādhayiṣyati
verses.translation: "Oh, brave Angada, this mission of yours will not be thwarted in the least. I will motivate him who achieves success of this mission of searching Seetha...

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रतीतम् प्लवताम् वरिष्ठम्
एकांतम् आश्रित्य सुखोपविष्टम् |
संचोदयामास हरि प्रवीरो
हरिप्रवीरम् हनुमंतम् एव
verses.iast:
tataḥ pratītam plavatām variṣṭham
ekāṃtam āśritya sukhopaviṣṭam |
sañcodayāmāsa hari pravīro
haripravīram hanumaṃtam eva
verses.translation: Then Jambavanta, the outstanding one among monkeys started to motivate the exceptional fly-jumper, and a marvellous one among all the monkeys, and who by now is comfortably sitting abiding a lonely place, namely Hanuma.
notes: Here Hanuma is said to be sitting 'comfortably' far from the madding crowd of monkeys. When everybody is clamorous how can this monkey sit comfortably - is the doubt. In reply it is said, that he is apparently comfortable but in his heart of hearts the problem of vaulting over the ocean is churning. On one hand, Rama gave his golden ring to Hanuma in the presence of these very same monkey heroes, and on the other Angada is asking all the other monkeys to jump over the ocean. Hanuma is fully aware that all the other monkeys are somehow escaping the situation, not because they cannot jump just a hundred yojana ocean, but owing to the fear of Ravana. Hanuma neither fears Ravana nor cares his stooge-demons, but his concern himself with his duty. If somebody comes forward to leap, then it is well and good and Hanuma has to accompany that monkey as a standby, because he is handling the ring of Rama. If none comes forward, even in that event he has go to Lanka unaccompanied. In either case it is Hanuma who has to go, hence the 'comfortableness' is 'decisiveness' and thus he is decided of his duty. A verse from Skanda Puraana says this only:
nīlo añgado hanūmān ca jāmbavān atha kesarī | samudra tīram āgamya na śekuḥ spanditum padam | rāvaṇasya balam jñātvā tīre nada nadī pateḥ | skānda purāṇa

glosses.meaning: among moneys, marvellous one, Hanuma, alone
